== Notes ==
* The resurrected party member must be within [[casting range]].
* The resurrected party member cannot activate skills with a cast time for 1 second, although they can still move and use skills with no cast time.
* The bonus does not affect [[Health Regeneration]] (such as from [[Healing Breeze]]), the healing from [[Divine Favor]], nor indirect healing from enchantments (such as [[Dwayna's Sorrow]]). For details, see [[Heal#Healing modifiers|healing modifiers]].
* When dismissed, this skill can resurrect even if the caster or target is in [[Frozen Soil]] range. However, it cannot be ''cast'' while under the effects of Frozen Soil.  The monk can retreat out of range, cast this skill, move back in and cancel it to resurrect.
* If maintaining this skill when you die, another dead party member will resurrect at your corpse. However, if the resurrected party member is a [[hero]] or [[henchman]] with no resurrection skills, your [[death]] counts toward the party [[wipe]].
** If a party [[resign]]s while one or more of them are maintaining this skill, the enchantments will end and resurrect players even after they have resigned.
* Heroes dismiss Unyielding Aura the instant a party member dies in range to resurrect them. They also give a low priority to re-casting it during combat.
* This skill, [[Eternal Aura]], [["By Ural's Hammer!"]], and [["We Shall Return!"]] are the fastest resurrection skills.
* In parties with death penalty removal consumables in high end quests, resurrecting at full health and especially at full energy is valued greatly over the increase in healing output.

{{Anomaly|The tiny delay between the target being teleported to the casters location and being resurrected is long enough for an AI to possibly use "We Shall Return!", which takes place before UA's resurrecting effect.}}
{{Anomaly|The "random" resurrected party member is almost always the one closest to the caster when the skill is cancelled.  You can therefor pick which target to rez by moving on top of the corpse before cancelling.}}
{{bug|If you are moving when it ends, the resurrected party member will be [[teleport]]ed to where you started running or where you last changed direction, not to your current position.}}

== Trivia ==
* Since the [[Game updates/20080910|September 10, 2008 update]], the dead party member must be within [[casting range]] to be resurrected when the enchantment ends. Before that, this spell would resurrect a party member from any location on the map.
